newsitem.title: UK: BA Nov passenger traffic up 11.4 pct.
newsitem.headline: BA Nov passenger traffic up 11.4 pct.

text.p: British Airways Plc said on Wednesday paying passenger traffic in November rose 11.4 percent but capacity increased 8.9 percent to give an overall load factor of 68.9 percent -- up 1.5 percentage points on a year ago.
Britain's national flag carrier said it had seen a rise in its all-important premium business of 7.4 percent but that growth in non-premium traffic was even stronger at 12.3 percent.
BA said it expected faster growth in longhaul and non-premium traffic for the remainder of the year, which would dampen its passenger yields.
The recent strengthening of sterling against the major currencies in which BA sells would also have a negative effect on revenue, BA added.
Cargo traffic in November in terms of cargo kilometres was up by 3.5 percent.
